findings.fact: Exact native wire profile is1152 bytes, CommandLine1024 at108, tails1136/1144. Common prefix includes six64-bit video fields, machine_type32, devtree64 and devtree_size32 at real ABI offsets. External exact profile is mandatory; Revision2/Version2 remain2/2 and are not used as format selection.

Encoder consumes explicit plain source fields, including boot_flags and mem_size_actual, with exact unsigned width/type checks and no coercion. It does not read native sizeof bytes or recover tails from legacy offsets. Output is immutable zero-initialized canonical bytes with all reserved padding zero. Input dictionaries remain unchanged.

Command preserves all ASCII bytes except NUL, including whitespace/control bytes, with1023 maximum plus terminator. Strict decode requires immutable exact1152 bytes, R2/V2, zero reserved padding, ASCII through first NUL and only zero trailing command fill. This is a byte codec; no boot-argument policy filtering or shell interpretation is claimed.

Legacy736 payload is not silently accepted by length/revision fallback. Padded legacy bytes with nonzero old tails are refused as command trailing bytes. A zero-tail legacy payload padded to1152 can be identical to native canonical bytes; the design correctly relies on externally bound producer/profile provenance rather than claiming impossible byte-level discrimination or relabeling captures.

Plan validates exact supplied allocation fields, unsigned base/size/address, nonempty nonwrapping mathematical extent, address alignment and full1152-byte containment. Immutable bytes and frozen metadata are returned without accepting a target/proxy/callback/writer. End may equal2^64 as an exclusive mathematical bound, not a wrapped u64 pointer. Review digest is a binding label, not allocation/RAM/MCC ownership authentication.
